column1: # Answer keys, written 2026-10-14 BEFORE any model was given these documents. Scored by tools/score-draft.py.
# Checks are on BEHAVIOUR, never on names: a "reading for X" is any `observe` whose cited manual sentence contains
# the text X (case-insensitive). The scorer evaluates the draft itself (tools/refcheck.py semantics), so a draft cbc
#   lead     <X> <class>    with the reading for X set, alone or with the fewest other readings (up to two) that make
#                           it matter, the action chosen is of this class:
#   rest     -   idle       with nothing set, the idle action is chosen and it is not the safe one
#   worst    <X>|<Y> safe   with both readings set, the safe action is chosen (shutdown outranks alarm)
#   differ   <X>|<Y> -      the two readings lead to different actions
#   excuse   <X>|<E> less   the reading for X leads to a non-idle action, and adding the reading for E changes it to
#                           one that is not the safe action
#   matters  <X> -          a reading for X exists and changes the decision with up to two other readings
# Where several readings cite matching sentences, the check passes if any one of them behaves as required.
#   noaction <regex> -      no action's name matches the regex
# doc  id  check  args  expect  rule (plain words)
